verdict.rationale: HubSpot's knowledge base documents connecting an individual work inbox so users can send one-to-one emails from the CRM and log email replies to the CRM. That covers the core of connected-email logging and a send/receive loop. However, the evidence never names Gmail or Outlook, never describes true two-way mailbox sync, and never explains how logged emails are matched to the correct contact, company or deal records. Missing for 10: explicit Gmail/Outlook provider support, documented two-way sync behavior, automatic association of emails to the right records, independent or hands-on corroboration.
